name: Elmify
audience: Master's degree applicants in Azerbaijan and worldwide (MSc, MA, LLM, MRes)
Study-abroad agencies and educational counsellors in Baku and abroad
capabilities: Reads official university and scholarship pages for master's degrees with sentence-level source links
Evaluates student GPA, Bachelor's ECTS credits, IELTS/TOEFL/TestDaF scores, citizenship, and AZN/EUR/GBP/USD budgets against programme and funder rules

Groups matched master's programmes under the scholarship that funds them across both flagship national scholarships (Azerbaijan State Program Dövlət Proqramı 2022–2028, HTP / Stipendium Hungaricum, Erasmus Mundus, DAAD, Swedish Institute SISGP, Chevening, Türkiye Bursları, NL Scholarship) and 5 low-competition funding layers (automatic faculty waivers like French IdEx/LabEx, Italian regional DSU income-based grants, Visegrad/ADB-JSP regional bloc funds, local-language Stiftungen/vakıflar, and departmental RA/TA assistantships)
Generates zero-fabrication academic CVs, programme-specific motivation letters, scholarship essays, and distinct referee talking-point briefs
Provides a glass-box browser extension co-pilot that autofills verified fields and approved PDFs on official portals (DreamApply, uni-assist, Studielink) while stopping before the Submit button
Provides a white-label trilingual (AZ/EN/RU) multi-counsellor application management workspace for study-abroad agencies
